title: Steam Machine Garners Attention in Austria
description: Valve's Steam Machine is trending in Austria with CAD files released under Creative Commons and AMD FSR 4.1 support.

sources.title: Valve Releases Steam Machine CAD Files Under Creative Commons License - Is the GameCube Handle Finally Possible?
Steam Machine reservation queue should be caught up by the end of 2026, Valve says
Steam Machine gets AMD FSR 4.1 support and official external CAD files

sections.heading: Steam Machine CAD Files
paragraphs: Digital Foundry reports that Valve has released CAD files for the Steam Machine under a Creative Commons license, allowing for customization and potential unique designs.

sections.heading: AMD FSR 4.1 Support
paragraphs: VideoCardz.com notes that the Steam Machine has received support for AMD's FidelityFX Super Resolution (FSR) 4.1, enhancing the gaming experience.

sections.heading: Reservation Queue Update
paragraphs: PC Gamer cites Valve stating that the Steam Machine reservation queue should be caught up by the end of 2026.

faq.a: A Steam Machine is a device developed by Valve that allows users to play games from the Steam platform on their television.
CAD files are important for hardware design and customization, enabling users and manufacturers to create unique Steam Machine designs.
AMD FSR 4.1 is a technology that improves game performance and image quality, beneficial for Steam Machine users.
